entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The cabin the target's in is right there!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Indeed, I can sense someone within[n]its walls.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What should we do, Joker?
Check inside.
Nothing for now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, here goes.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You're right. We should time this[n]operation properly.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Aw yeah, we got the fourth letter![n]He might've been a third-rate guy,[n]but he still had one somehow!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Just that cleaner dude left then.[n]Wanna go cause a scene somewhere[n]and lure him out?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: As I've already said, we should avoid[n]doing that if we can.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But we've gone everywhere on the map.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Is there any place we haven't checked yet...?
The cabins.
The engine room.
The wheelhouse.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: True, we have not examined every single[n]room yet... but is doing so truly worth it?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm? I don't ever recall passing by[n]such a place.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: True, we have yet to see that...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It might be in a different place than[n]normal. Shido wants to steer the[n]entire country, after all...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wait, I found something...[n]The engine room.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Remember how you were wondering[n]about that smoke earlier, Skull?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh yeah... Where was that?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Where are we?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It looks like we've come out on the side[n]deck. We should be able to secure a route[n]from here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Welp, let's head over and get to usin'[n]those letters then.
